title: How to route around moving elevators
summary: Plan lane transfers instead of fighting the elevator cycle, and keep a buffer lane open for returned blocks.

seo.title: Route Around Block Out Moving Elevators
seo.description: Plan Block Out routes around moving elevators by reading the cycle, using transfers and keeping a buffer lane open.

question: How should I plan a Block Out route when elevators move my blocks between lanes?

sections.heading: Read the cycle before you move
body: Watch one full elevator cycle to learn which lane a block returns to.
Commit only blocks whose route still works after the transfer.

sections.heading: Use the transfer as a free move
body: When the cycle clearly helps, load a stuck color onto the elevator instead of forcing a longer manual path.
Keep the return lane clear so the block lands where you want it.

sections.heading: Hold a buffer lane
body: Always keep one lane open as a landing spot for returned blocks.
A buffer prevents the elevator from stranding a piece you still need.
